title: Agent roles cannot call the session tools, and a lint keeps it so
why: Agent roles could call the claude-code-remote session tools (send, interrupt, create sessions), which belong to orchestrators; a stray interrupt_session from a record-writer on 2026-11-01 is one case.
note: Deny mcp__claude-code-remote__* through disallowedTools in agents/*.md for reviewer, test-author, builder, record-writer, designer, design-reviewer, Explore and Plan, plus a lint check that keeps it. Finding B (round-2 reviewer on Sonnet) is no defect. Topic agent-roles. Absorbs step explore-no-create-session (coordinator, 17:32 CST): an Explore agent in lane replay-profile-parts made a stray session through create_session; that incident is this lane's red test. 18:19 CST Nov 7: #1674 (agents-no-remote-tools: the guard refuses an agent's outward claude-code-remote calls, all 20 tools) is with runner 8, stacked on #1566. Sighting (coordinator, 04:26 CST Nov 8): a fix-check reviewer in lane session_013NEJL2xaiFZSCyk6vknwcT (map-names-any-file) called create_session. Lane map-names-any-file (session_013NEJL2xaiFZSCyk6vknwcT) reported at 04:27 CST that it is building this step too (incident: the #1331 fix-check reviewer called create_session at 04:05 CST and left an empty session, now archived). Two lanes on one step: sent to the coordinator.
